title: Burj Khalifa Ki Top Se Kya Dikhta Hai? 🏙️ #shorts
idea: Burj Khalifa's tip is so high that its tip can be seen from 95 kilometers away.

lines.text: Burj Khalifa duniya ki sabse unchi building hai!
Iski height sunkar aapke hosh udd jaayenge.
Yahan tak ki iski tip 95 kilometers door se dikh sakti hai!
Iske top par khade hokar log Ramadan mein 3 minute late fast todte hain!
Isme lagbhag 24 thousand se zyada windows hain!
Kya aap itni unchai par kabhi jaana chahenge?
